d: We are seeking a qualified and compassionate Midwife to provide comprehensive maternity care throughout pregnancy, labor, birth, and the postnatal period. The successful candidate will support the health and wellbeing of mothers and newborns through evidence-based clinical practice, patient education, and collaboration with multidisciplinary healthcare teams while ensuring compliance with NHRA standards.
q: Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Midwifery or Nursing with Midwifery qualification.
Valid NHRA Midwife License or eligibility for NHRA licensing.
Minimum 3–5 years of recent Midwifery experience in a hospital or maternity setting.
BLS certification required; NRP certification preferred.
Strong communication, interpersonal, and teamwork skills.
Ability to provide compassionate, patient-centered maternity care.
Candidates outside Bahrain are welcome to apply and must be willing to relocate.
r: Provide antenatal, intrapartum, postnatal, and newborn care.
Monitor maternal and fetal wellbeing throughout pregnancy and childbirth.
Assist with labour and delivery, ensuring safe and high-quality maternity care.
Educate mothers and families on pregnancy, breastfeeding, and newborn care.
Maintain accurate clinical documentation and patient records.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary healthcare teams to deliver patient-centered care.
Participate in quality improvement and professional development activities.

d: Company Description Talent International & The Infant School, licensed by the Ministry of Education in the Kingdom of Bahrain, offers a first-class Cambridge and English National curriculum for learners from 3 months to 18 years old across primary, intermediate, and secondary grades. Established in 1971 as a preschool, the school has grown steadily, adding higher stages and a Day Care unit for infants starting at 3 months. With branches including the Riffa campus opened in 1988, the school maintains a friendly, family-like environment that encourages students to feel welcomed and engaged. Talent International prepares learners for Cambridge IGCSE, AS, and A Levels, as well as internal secondary examinations, and is recognized as an official Edexcel learning and examination centre and a Cambridge Associate school.

Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Teaching Assistant role based in the Capital Governorate, Bahrain. The Teaching Assistant will support classroom teachers in delivering lessons, reinforcing learning activities, and assisting with classroom management across various age groups. Daily responsibilities include helping prepare teaching materials, guiding students in small groups or one-to-one, and supporting learners with diverse educational needs. The role also involves supervising students during transitions and breaks, assisting with basic assessment and record-keeping tasks, and contributing to a safe, inclusive, and nurturing school environment aligned with the school’s curriculum and values.
